overall_explanation:
Communication-content acceptance remains NOT_READY. Each obligation was assessed separately for sourceAccuracy, readerUsability, and quality:
COM-001 NOT_READY: broad matrix exists, but endpoint coverage and per-connection contract/limit details are incomplete. SourceAccuracy: incomplete; readerUsability: insufficient as an exhaustive inventory; quality: completeness claim exceeds coverage.
COM-003 NOT_READY: topology and durable agent-job boundary are useful, but native operation restart states and safe continuation decisions are missing. SourceAccuracy: partial; readerUsability: reconciliation is underspecified; quality: end-to-end recovery coverage incomplete.
COM-004 NOT_READY: actual gateway envelope, current Echo protocols, completion/import branches, and streaming boundary are absent. SourceAccuracy: transport description imprecise; readerUsability and quality: insufficient integration detail.
COM-005 NOT_READY: full invocation/result/cancellation shapes and isolated IPC protocol are missing. SourceAccuracy: incomplete; readerUsability and quality: distinct transport contracts cannot be reconstructed from this page.
COM-008 NOT_READY: implemented probe routes and required per-route fields are omitted. SourceAccuracy, readerUsability, quality: catalogue remains selective.
COM-009 NOT_READY: private routes and temporary exposure share a generic summary without their distinct owners, configured DNS/TLS/identity boundaries, and control protocol. SourceAccuracy: incomplete; readerUsability and quality: route-level operational detail missing.
COM-010 NOT_READY: independently authenticated and bounded Git/build/push/verify/pull/mirror transitions are collapsed. SourceAccuracy: incomplete; readerUsability and quality: configuration and recovery bindings insufficient.
COM-011 NOT_READY: no complete workload-ID/SAN/port/allowlist/network-policy matrix or sourced rotation boundary. All three aspects remain incomplete.
COM-012 NOT_READY: generic bounds omit concrete isolated IPC limits, observer required/best-effort retry and stop behavior, and build/verification shared deadlines. SourceAccuracy: incomplete failure model; readerUsability and quality: pressure and retry ownership insufficiently explicit.
The page appropriately labels live acceptance as unverified and historical rationale as unknown or inference; those are not defects. COM-002/006/007 scopes are not reopened. No tests, deployments, product effects, file modifications, or nested reviewers were used.

Ignored 8 out-of-scope finding(s) outside the reviewed change.
